name: Prawn & Egg Fried Rice
method: Cook the rice, drain and spread out to cool a little.
Fry the chopped onion and garlic in half the oil for 5 minutes. Add the prawns and cook until pink, then push to the side.
Pour the beaten eggs into the pan and scramble briefly, then add the rice, peas and green vegetables and stir-fry over a high heat for 4 to 5 minutes.
Season with the soy sauce and vinegar and serve scattered with sliced spring onion.
